status: Recommendations only; none applied to ROM data

changes.rule: Only apply Flying-move priority bonus while the holder is at full HP

example_sets.purpose: Rain-boosted Smash: compare before and after the family timing restriction. Drizzle does not also boost pulses; White Herb is absent from this game.
Pulse-based Smash: compare against the Drizzle build without stacking abilities; no Steel STAB in this four-move version.
Sleep plus multi-hit Grass and boosted priority; item access is a separate campaign question.
Recovery/control alternative. No Technician damage or Swords Dance in this version.
Current fast control baseline; after the proposal replace Spore with existing Sleep Powder. This version has no direct attack.
Current boost-passing baseline; after removal replace Baton Pass with existing Psychic. No accuracy ability is stacked.
Current team amplification baseline; after removal use an independent attacking or hazard set. This version cannot attack.
Special setup/recovery pressure, without absent Stored Power. Compare Forewarn after the proposed ability change.
Test priority at full and damaged HP, after recoil, hazards and healing. The proposed restriction changes those states.
Free-hit setup pressure before/after Attack 100 to 90; do not simultaneously add Disguise chip in the first pass.
Versatile current 720-BST special offense versus the proposed 600-BST build; recovery is absent from this set.
Test recorded fallen counts 0 through 5; Sharpness is not part of this set.
Test hit-history buildup and persistence at the implemented 250-power cap, with healing and setup opportunity costs.
Check duplicate secondary effects, drain, Substitute interactions and quarter-strength second-hit damage.
Compare Dire Claw disabling frequency before/after 50 to 30, alongside Technician priority; Dire Claw itself is above the Technician threshold.
Test the redesigned 110-HP/95-Speed physical attacker with status costs and recoil present.
Test actual available Berry Juice rather than importing a Sitrus Berry; healing amount and HP state must be controlled.
Multi-hit sweeps versus special attackers, priority and full-HP defensive abilities. White Herb is absent, so defensive drops remain meaningful.
Test the time required for 43-base-Speed artillery to pass actual Speed benchmarks. No Levitate or Sticky Web in this version.
Converted Normal damage with recovery versus existing Flying resistances; no Intimidate/Moxie stacked.
Test damage-derived healing and priority after setup, with recoil and actual counters.
Recovery loop baseline; this four-move version has neither Stealth Rock nor Swords Dance.
Core defensive identity; compare added Spikes on a separate four-move build before using removal as a nerf. Black Sludge is absent.
Eviolite special/physical bulk comparison versus Porygon-Z, item removal and Fighting attackers.
Special wall and fixed-damage baseline at zero and high stat experience, including physical critical hits and item loss.
Priority disruption without stacking Levitate; test Dark-target restrictions and repeated recovery cycles.
Defensive evolution comparison against Cursola with the item and actual role kept explicit.
Eviolite/Stamina bulk versus Archaludon; no recovery or Electric coverage in this version.
Converted Electric priority with Ground immunities and Armor Tail/Queenly Majesty answers checked.
Slow Grass/Fire sun setter; do not also grant Chlorophyll or Solar Power. Test five versus eight weather turns.
Priority drain/healing baseline; does not also receive Mega Sol's personal sun-like effects.
Personal sun-like effects without team weather or Triage. Test under rain and Neutralizing Gas.
Current physical Bug/Fighting redesign: recovery, coverage and priority; no Technician is stacked.
Slow Bug/Ghost sleep support; compare with Jumpluff's very different 110-Speed control profile.
Custom mitigation on the redesigned 150-Defense/100-Sp.Def slow tank; Shell Smash is not also in this version.
Low-BST damage benchmark with doubled physical damage, without Intimidate on entry.
Current support baseline; after the proposed addition replace Rest with Slack Off and assess the new recovery loop.
Current tank baseline; after the proposal replace Rest with Slack Off. Slush Rush is a separate setup test, and Scald is not in this species' current pool.
Current bulky offensive baseline; replace one attack with proposed Volt Switch to evaluate the pivot buff. No status moves with Assault Vest.
Current fast Grass/Electric utility; proposed Synthesis replaces one utility move rather than becoming a fifth slot.
Assess Defense 55 to 65 without also adding recovery or special bulk; paralysis consumes the coverage slot.
Assess HP 50 to 60 on the Steel utility attacker; Bulldoze qualifies for Technician at its stored 60 power.
